r=Robot(); o=r.get_obs(video='none'); p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14],float); q=p[3:].copy();
def seg(a,b,spacing=.006,dt=.1):
 a=np.array(a,float);b=np.array(b,float); n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b[:3]-a[:3])/spacing)));return np.linspace(a,b,n+1)[1:]

 global p
 end=np.array(end,float); rows=seg(p,end,.007)

 p=np.array(rr.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14],float); print('move',p[:3],rr.meta['ok'],sum(x['ik_failures'] for x in rr.meta['plan']))
def stroke(x,z):
 global p
 start=np.array([x,-.225,z,*q]); end=np.array([x,-.145,z,*q])
 move_to([*start[:3],*q]); p[:3]=start[:3] # commanded aligned
 rows=list(seg(start,end,.006)); rows += [end]*3
 rr=r.submit('ee_pose',rows,dt=.1,cameras=['practice_cam','side_cam'],video='none')
 p=np.array(rr.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14],float); print('stroke at',x,z,'end',p[:3],rr.meta['ok'])
 # lift
 move_to([x,-.145,.25,*q])
# navigate from ink to practice clear height
move_to([-.1,-.1856,.25,*q])
for x,z in [(-.16,.010),(-.10,.006),(-.04,.002)]: stroke(x,z)
o=r.get_obs(cameras=['practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],video='none')
for cam,img in o.last.items():
 from PIL import Image

+def resample_polyline(xy, spacing):

+    # distance so the brush speed and pressure are steady along each stroke.
